result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with truncated content and a minor display formatting issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally clipped/cut off on the right side. The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be incomplete (likely 'Trattoria Piccolo'), and the full card content is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel or container width to ensure all three cards are fully visible within the scrollable area, or implement proper horizontal scrolling that makes it clear more items are available.

issues.description: The second item in 'Popular right now' section displays '-0%' which is visually awkward and confusing. A negative zero discount is unusual and doesn't clearly communicate the offer to users.
issues.suggestion: Replace '-0%' with 'No discount', 'Free delivery', or omit the discount badge entirely if there is no active promotion.
